sessionStart.bash: if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/copilot-session-start.cjs"; else desk_host=copilot; . "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/node-missing.sh"; fi
sessionStart.powershell: if (Get-Command node -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { node "${PLUGIN_ROOT}\hooks\copilot-session-start.cjs" } else { $nodeDir = @($env:ProgramFiles + '\nodejs') + @(([Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','Machine') + ';' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','User')) -split ';') + @($env:NVM_SYMLINK) + @(Get-ChildItem -Path ($env:LOCALAPPDATA + '\fnm\node-versions\*\installation') -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }) | Where-Object { $_ -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $_ 'node.exe')) } | Select-Object -First 1; if ($nodeDir) { $text = 'Desk needs Node.js 22.18 or newer. It is installed at ' + (Join-Path $nodeDir 'node.exe') + ', but it is not on this session''s PATH, because the app or service that started this session was started before Node was installed (or with an older PATH), so the Desk tool servers (desk, desk-web) cannot run and Desk tools do not work in this session. Restart the app or background service that started this session, or open a new terminal and start the session from there; there is nothing to install.'; @{ additionalContext = $text } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress } elseif ($env:NVM_HOME) { '{"additionalContext":"Desk needs Node.js 22.18 or newer, and this machine has no Node.js (no `node` on PATH), so the Desk tool servers (desk, desk-web) cannot run and Desk tools do not work in this session. Install it: run `nvm install lts` and then `nvm use lts` in a terminal. Then the person must open a new terminal and start a new session, because tool servers load only when a session starts."}' } else { '{"additionalContext":"Desk needs Node.js 22.18 or newer, and this machine has no Node.js (no `node` on PATH), so the Desk tool servers (desk, desk-web) cannot run and Desk tools do not work in this session. Install it: run `winget install --id OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS --exact --accept-source-agreements --accept-package-agreements` in a terminal. Then the person must open a new terminal and start a new session, because tool servers load only when a session starts."}' } }
